title: Citations & Fact-Check Output
description: Output of fact-check-and-citation skill. Stored at memory/workspace/{task_id}/citations.json. Replaces [claim:cN_S] markers in section markdown with (Author, Year) format.

refs.description: Final References section entries, APA 7 format

domain.description: Registrable host of the source (e.g. 'doi.org', 'designlights.org'). Optional audit field added 2026-06-20 for the competitor-citation guard. Populated by the fact-checker so downstream layers can confirm no competitor domain slipped in.

resolved_status.description: HTTP status code from link_resolver.py HEAD check, or 'bot-403' marker when a .gov/.edu page is known to UA-block automated checks but resolves for human readers

confidence_score.description: Source authority. 1.0 = peer-reviewed journal, 0.7 = major publisher, 0.3 = blog

deleted_claims.description: Claims whose sources couldn't be verified after 3 retries; LLM rewrote text to remove the claim

rejected_competitor_domains.description: Audit trail (added 2026-06-20): source URLs/domains the fact-checker discarded because they matched the project's citation_source_policy.do_not_cite_domains blocklist. Each entry was either re-sourced to a neutral authority or its claim was dropped. Empty/absent = no competitor source was encountered.
